verdict.rationale: Railway documents custom dashboards with metrics from any service, centralized logs, and condition-based alerts. This gives a devops lead some service-level performance visibility. There is no evidence of built-in visitor or behavior analytics such as page views, user sessions, or web vitals. Missing for 10: visitor behavior analytics, site-level performance metrics (e.g. latency or web vitals per page), detail on which metrics dashboards expose, independent corroboration.
